object.attr: stakeholder: whoever makes a link reads the target while making it, so a new link starts OK. MELLON-TRACE-SRS-18 and MELLON-TRACE-SRS-21 make sure that the last change is what the creator read. Copies and links made again keep an earlier review instead.
